controls: same pinned endpoint, account, inventory, release profile, reuse policy and fourteen calls; no assistant builds/tests during formal timing
uncontrolled: network, host/guest load, caches, background machine activity; password/idle intervals between processes vary
timing: each session includes client setup, TLS, Login, inventory, XML parsing and Logout; excludes terminal password entry and final JSON printing
rss: Linux process lifetime high-water; three sessions per process; not per-session allocation bound
license_probe: correctness evidence only; not a completed-transfer timing or paired sample
